time.desc: The university involved announced in a public notice that it had withdrawn the disciplinary sanctions against the accused students, and stated that after review, the accuser's degree would be maintained and the relevant responsible personnel would be held accountable.

The court announced the results of the second instance of the sexual harassment civil dispute: it rejected the appeal, upheld the original judgment, and confirmed that all the plaintiff’s claims were not supported.
The parties involved spoke out on social accounts to defend themselves and had public disputes with others, triggering a new round of attention.

The person involved posted on his social account that he had "passed a certain public recruitment exam" and then changed his statement to deny it. This was accused by public opinion of being false information that created a topic.
The second instance of the sexual harassment liability dispute concluded, the court rejected the appeal and upheld the original verdict
The party committee secretary of the university involved was replaced, and the new secretary took office
The university involved focused on refuting many key online rumors in the report
The university involved formed a five-member expert team to complete the review and announced the scale of the investigation and the conclusion that the paper did not involve plagiarism.
The accuser spoke out intensively on social platforms to communicate with the outside world and defended himself. The incident was filed in the relevant false accusation theme archives by We Media.

The party involved filed an appeal to the higher court within about 20 days after losing the first instance. During this period, someone called the court and learned that the case was being heard in the second instance.

The accused party filed an appeal last year after losing the first instance of an administrative lawsuit against relevant institutions regarding demerit penalties. As of this stage, the final result has not been made public.
At the same time as the judicial proceedings of the university involved were concluded, the party committee secretary was replaced, and the new secretary took office.
In the review notification, the school suspended the relevant tutors' enrollment qualifications for two years, and gave several managers intra-party warnings or admonishments.
The school clarified in the briefing that the rumor that a relative of the accuser holds a certain title within the school is untrue.
